name: Akuyaku Reijou no Danzai made Ato 3 Turn
original_name: 悪役令嬢の断罪まであと3ターン
source:
Duchess Gloria de Montague found herself at a party. She then realized that she had been reincarnated into the world of an otome game. And...
　
''I only have three turns left before my fate is decided~!''
　
Three more turns to go until the “Absolution Event!''. Can you manage it! Will you fail and die?　
Is this game [i]even[/i] a comedy?
　
''It's a comedy~!!''

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28929]Freem![/url]]
translation:
格洛丽亚·德·蒙塔古公爵夫人发现自己正在参加一场聚会。她这才意识到，自己转生到了乙女游戏的世界。

“我的命运只剩下三回合了！”

距离“赦免事件”还有三回合。她能成功吗？还是会失败并死去？
这款游戏[i]居然[/i]是一部喜剧吗？

“这是一部喜剧！”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/28929]Freem![/url]]
